attempts.prompt_user:
Document kind: chat
Title: #north-random (export, no date)
Date: UNDATED. Do not include any date, year, month name, weekday, or relative date reference ("yesterday", "last week") anywhere in the document.
Writer: Marcus Lindqvist
Voice: terse and practical
Format: a chat log with [HH:MM] timestamps and lowercase usernames
Length: about 365 words
Date style in the body: mixed: some ISO, some casual (ignore: undated)
Typos: one or two small natural typos (never in names or required phrases)

Brief:
An undated Slack export from the North team's random channel: lunch orders, a fantasy football argument, someone asking whether Dana's Slack account is broken because her status is stuck, and a passing comment about one account. Do not include any dates or weekdays.

Required phrases:
- Use the exact phrase "Dana's freight account" once, but vaguely: the writer does not say which account it is, and nothing nearby (name, location, numbers, products) may identify one. Keep that sentence generic, like a passing comment.
- Use the exact phrase "Dana's Slack account" once, in the sense of: her login on the chat tool. It must not be about a customer account.
- Use the exact phrase "Marcus's freight account" once, but vaguely: the writer does not say which account it is, and nothing nearby (name, location, numbers, products) may identify one. Keep that sentence generic, like a passing comment.

Background (fictional world; use only what the document needs):
People:
- Ruth Calloway: Chief Revenue Officer; runs the Strategic Accounts pod
- Anselm Grieve: CFO; approves discounts over 10%
- June Osei-Lark: Deal desk and contracts manager
- Moss: Ruth's AI assistant; writes agent notes (an AI assistant)
- Ilse Varga: North team lead
- Dana Okafor: Account manager, North team
- Marcus Lindqvist: Account manager, North team
- Thea Ramaswell: Director of Yard Operations
- Felix Duarte: Account executive at Stoneharrow Billing, Pemberline's billing vendor

Customer accounts in this part of the business:
- Quarrendon Freight Lines: truckload freight carrier, Upper Midwest; main contact Thea Ramaswell, Director of Yard Operations; codes/nicknames QFL, Q-Freight
- Brackenwater Freight Co.: less-than-truckload freight, Great Lakes; codes/nicknames BWF, Bracken
- Tamsin Cold Chain: refrigerated warehousing, Pacific Northwest; codes/nicknames TCC
- Orrin Mills: textile mill, Carolinas; codes/nicknames ORM, TCC

Other companies:
- Pemberline Systems: The company whose knowledge base this is. Sells Pemberline Dock, a yard and dock scheduling product, priced per seat per year.
- Quarendon Freightways: A trucking company that is not a customer; it uses a competitor's yard software. Look-alike of Quarrendon Freight Lines.
- Stoneharrow Billing: Pemberline's billing and invoicing vendor. Pemberline is the customer here.

Who manages what (background only; don't restate unless the brief asks):
(This page is undated. Do not state who manages which account.)

# #north-random (export, no date)

[11:42] marcus.lindqvist: putting in the sandwich order from the corner deli. cutoff in ten mins.

[11:43] ilse.varga: turkey club on sourdough for me, no tomato. thanks marcus.

[11:44] marcus.lindqvist: got it.

[11:45] ilse.varga: also you are crazy for offering a backup tight end for my WR2 in the league. rejected.

[11:46] marcus.lindqvist: he gets red zone targets. your roster is half on IR anyway.

[11:47] ilse.varga: still a robbery.

[11:48] marcus.lindqvist: anyone hear from dana on lunch? her little status icon has said "stepping out for coffee" for hours. is Dana's Slack account broken or is she actually AFK?

[11:50] ilse.varga: desktop app probably froze again. she was typing in a thread earlier while the coffee icon was still up.

[11:51] marcus.lindqvist: classic. i'll just get her the usual pesto chicken panini then so she doesnt starve.

[11:52] ilse.varga: safe bet.

[11:54] dana.okafor: wait i'm here! sorry, app was totally glitched out, had to force quit twice. yes to the panini please.

[11:55] marcus.lindqvist: already in the cart.

[11:56] dana.okafor: lifesaver. also ilse do not trade with him, he fleeced me on a running back swap and i'm still bottom of the standings.

[11:57] marcus.lindqvist: it was a fair trade at the time, not my fault the guy pulled a hamstring.

[11:58] ilse.varga: exactly why i hit decline. btw before we all eat, reminder to pull your slide screenshots for the deck review.

[11:59] marcus.lindqvist: yeah i grabbed the slide for Marcus's freight account already, just need to crop the header.

[12:00] dana.okafor: nice. i still need to drop in the blurb for Dana's freight account after i finish eating, shouldn't take long.

[12:01] ilse.varga: cool, no rush, just need the deck clean before the afternoon sync.

[12:02] marcus.lindqvist: order is placed. receipt is in the expense folder. i'll walk over and grab the bags in twenty.

[12:03] dana.okafor: thank you!! clearing my cache now so my status stops lying to everyone.

[12:04] marcus.lindqvist: send me a real counteroffer for that WR while you're at it.

[12:05] ilse.varga: not happening, go get the sandwiches.
